No browser rendering, pointer placement, map, camera or live-provider test.

results.name: An empty collection has no invented metrics or activity
Review coverage and queue require usable retained review and confirmation events
Activity does not normalize impossible days or supply a missing time zone
Bundled photographs are source frames, not saved observations
Scopes exclude synthetic reports, synthetic locations and illustrations
Photo desk keeps saved source association and does not treat video as a still
Legacy unknown image dimensions use a valid inspection ratio
Image coordinates exclude letterbox padding and preserve actual image edges
Portrait photo coordinates exclude side padding and follow zoomed bounds
Unknown, zero-size and non-finite image geometry cannot produce a photo pin
Coordinates coverage excludes historical source reviews
Activity uses UTC record creation dates, not historical image dates
Outside-window and invalid creation dates do not populate activity bars
Workflow distribution counts current states with no seeded segments
Uncertainty acknowledges a question without inventing an answer
Rule and AI source counts come from retained issue sources
Visual candidates remain pending until an explicit human judgment
Review queue prioritizes unjudged candidates then older creation dates
A visual note preserves evidence and prior decisions while reopening review
Notes retain normalized image coordinates, category and explicit uncertainty
Notes reject missing media and video references
Notes reject out-of-frame, non-finite and malformed positions
Notes reject empty or oversized text, invalid categories and invalid timestamps
Duplicate note IDs and the per-record limit fail before mutation
Older records without annotations remain valid
Photo notes and original bytes round-trip together through a field pack
Metadata-only receipts preserve notes and honestly mark missing photo bytes
Workspace restore, import and export reject notes attached to another record's media
Duplicate note IDs are rejected on workspace restore
Historical photo notes retain fixed attribution, source date and absence of invented GPS
Evidence graph links human visual notes to the photo and human review
Replay preserves day-precision source dates and does not fabricate AI events
Replay includes retained AI, question decisions, visual notes and review history in order
Replay keeps invalid imported times visible at the end without inventing dates
